{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Sheath dress in silk satin with a subtle sheen, straight cut falling to mid-calf length, color #deb295 (soft beige), woven fabric.
Strappy pump heels in glossy patent leather, stiletto shape, color #e2ba9f, synthetic material.
Gold drop-earring studs in polished metal, teardrop shape, color #d8a98c, jewelry.

This ensemble works perfectly for an upscale wedding reception held at noon during autumn daylight because the silk sheath dress offers a noble drape that feels sophisticated yet comfortable enough for dining and dancing. The warm beige tones harmonize beautifully with her skin while remaining timeless enough to match any floral or neutral tablescapes in a restaurant setting. The strappy heels add necessary height and elegance without sacrificing comfort, completing the look as a polished guest ready for both ceremony and celebration."}
